func (rw *responseWriter) Close() error {
	// didn't write, probably head request
	if !rw.wroteHeader {
		cl, err := strconv.Atoi(rw.Header().Get("Content-Length"))
		if err == nil && cl > rw.config.MinLength {

		if rw.statusCode != 0 {

	}

	if rw.w != nil {

		if err == nil && cl > rw.config.MinLength {
